verdict.rationale: Grok Bot has no explicit project or space feature. Instead, each named Bot works as a context container: it keeps its memory, files, browser sessions and preferences across sessions (docs-5), and it is set up by describing its job (docs-2). A month-long user confirms that each bot owns its own context and domain (comm-2). Group chats and team channels also let several Bots and people share context (docs-3, docs-19). missing for 10: a dedicated project/space container for grouping related chats and files, documented shared project-level instructions, and evidence of organizing multiple threads under one workspace.
